objective.funnel_boundary: Target external funnel: confirmed app install -> approved exchange registration -> first deposit -> first spot trade -> D7 valid return -> reactivation session. The local playable only produces scenario-choice mission proofs and simulated operating records. Every external KPI remains zero until an approved exchange, app-store, attribution, ledger or order-system server callback is integrated.

reward.value_description: No real reward. Bricks and demo cards are non-transferable local SQLite game progress with no monetary value.
reward.material_terms: DEMO / LOCAL only; server validation creates no-value demo cards only. No fulfillment, redemption, transfer, purchase, investment or cash value.

compliance.promoted_activity: Local simulation of exchange growth marketing from acquisition through reactivation, with no actual financial promotion, account opening, deposit or transaction.

consent_requirements: Explicit local-storage consent before local alias registration
Guest entry requires no identity field

Future raw transcript retention, remote model use, remote analytics or external identity requires separate policy approval

measurement.deduplication_rule: Local SQLite enforces unique event_id. Production exchange KPIs require separate server-side user, event, campaign and time-window deduplication; local registration_complete remains a demo-alias event and is excluded from the external registration KPI.
measurement.bot_fraud_rule: LOCAL DEMO only. External acquisition and financial KPIs require approved anti-fraud, eligibility, region, account-status and abnormal-activity exclusion rules before production use.
measurement.source_of_truth: Local gameplay proof: SQLite events table written by server.py. External app install: approved app-store or attribution callback. External registration and return: approved exchange account backend. First deposit: approved exchange ledger. First spot trade: approved exchange order system. No external source is integrated in this build.

attribution.cross_device_policy: Local-device only; no cross-device stitching in DEMO / LOCAL.
exclusion_rules: exclude local QA aliases and local demo registration_complete
exclude ineligible region, age or account status
exclude reversed deposit and invalid or cancelled trade
never use local attribution for settlement

kill_switch.mechanism: Run python3 server.py --set-kill-switch on for the SQLite switch. Browser fallbacks: localStorage kol_town_kill_switch=1 or ?disabled=1.

notes: Version 0.10.0 defines a six-Campaign exchange lifecycle sandbox: app install, registration, first deposit, first spot trade, D7 return and reactivation session. Each Campaign has exactly one primary KPI and a separate local proof.
External KPI confirmation is fail-closed and remains zero because app-store, attribution, exchange account, ledger and order-system callbacks are not integrated.
Deposit and trade Campaigns require separate legal, compliance and risk approval before any production marketing use.
The local registration_complete event means demo alias creation only and is explicitly excluded from external exchange registration measurement.
Version 0.8.0 adds eight distinct enterable pre-rendered 3D interior game scenes.
The rendered Live2D model is official sample Mao, explicitly not Luna and not a digital twin; an authorized Luna Live2D model remains pending.
HK and minimum age 18 are assumptions, not approvals.
Claude Design is the structural baseline; public brand and likeness authorization remains pending.
